text: The AI output indicating a pituitary classification is inconclusive and must not be acted upon; it requires review by a qualified radiologist or specialist physician. The model evaluates only the appearance of the lesion and provides no information about hormonal activity or visual-pathway involvement, which are the principal factors guiding pituitary management [nci-pituitary-pdq] [ncbi-pituitary-adenoma-statpearls]. Pituitary tumours arise in the sellar region and may disturb hormone secretion and compress the optic chiasm, so diagnosis relies on pituitary-protocol MRI together with comprehensive endocrine testing rather than imaging alone [ncbi-pituitary-adenoma-statpearls] [nci-pituitary-pdq]. A clinician may wish to discuss a clinical examination for endocrine symptoms, detailed pituitary hormone evaluation, formal visual-field testing, a dedicated pituitary MRI protocol and multidisciplinary specialist review with endocrinology, neurosurgery and ophthalmology as appropriate [ncbi-pituitary-adenoma-statpearls] [nci-pituitary-diagnosis]. Symptoms such as sudden severe headache, rapid visual loss, new double vision, altered consciousness or signs of acute adrenal insufficiency should prompt urgent medical assessment [nci-pituitary-pdq] [ninds-brain-tumors].
